LESSON: WRITING 13.4.1 GUIDED WRITING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.4: Writing 13.4.1 Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 13.4.1 Guided Writing, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: What makes a sentence correct?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 13.4.1 Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Collaboration-learner’s team work spirit is enhanced as the learner plays sentence building drills collaboratively with peers.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation is enhanced as the learner works collaboratively with others in groups.

Link to

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: Self -esteem is enhanced as they use correct and meaningful sentences

Link to other Learning Areas:

Guided writing is practiced in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Pictures, assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips, page-turners, adapted digital devices

with filter keys/key guards/larger mouse/head control input devices such as head wand

Other Related Service Providers: Resource person, speech therapist, Learner support assistance, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist.
